title: Currencies
description: Manage currencies, symbols, and decimal places

help.title: About Currencies
help.overview: Currencies define how prices and sales amounts are labelled and displayed. Name, symbol, three-letter abbreviation, and decimal places from 0 to 8 are required.

sections.title: Manage currencies
items: Create or edit the display name, symbol, abbreviation, and decimal precision.
Deleting a currency is a soft delete and it can be restored.

sections.title: Historical amounts
items: Changing decimal places affects later display and entry rules; it does not rewrite historical amounts.
